purpose: Primary-source mechanism review for the current six-band TV-RRU study; no citation-count or PSNR ranking

sources.title: MoDL: Model Based Deep Learning Architecture for Inverse Problems
sources.authors: Hemant Kumar Aggarwal; Merry P. Mani; Mathews Jacob
sources.verified_mechanism: Shared learned CNN prior across unrolled iterations and numerical conjugate-gradient data-consistency blocks
sources.project_implication: Shared neural priors plus a physical solver are established mechanisms; this source does not validate six-band radiometry

sources.title: Simple Baselines for Image Restoration
sources.authors: Liangyu Chen; Xiaojie Chu; Xiangyu Zhang; Jian Sun
sources.reviewed: author abstract and version metadata; project NAFBlock implementation separately inspected
sources.verified_mechanism: Simplified restoration architecture replaces or removes standard nonlinear activations, including multiplicative operations
sources.project_implication: A useful backbone; multiplication still makes the network nonlinear, and restoration PSNR does not establish thermometry accuracy

sources.title: Degradation-Aware Unfolding Half-Shuffle Transformer for Spectral Compressive Imaging
sources.reviewed: abstract and method section 2.2, including equations 9 and the CASSI diagonal measurement-space normal
sources.verified_mechanism: Measurement/mask-conditioned iteration parameters; data step uses diagonal Phi Phi-transpose in the stated CASSI model
sources.project_implication: Conditioning is relevant; its diagonal CASSI update is not a replacement for the present weighted six-carrier operator

sources.title: LRDUN: A Low-Rank Deep Unfolding Network for Efficient Spectral Compressive Imaging
sources.authors: He Huang; Yujun Guo; Wei He
sources.reviewed: abstract and low-rank imaging/alternating-optimization method equations
sources.verified_mechanism: Low-rank spatial coefficients and spectral bases with physical rank much smaller than spectral channel count
sources.project_implication: Independent visible injections do not justify a hard low-rank constraint across all six outputs; thermal coordinate changes retain three degrees of freedom

sources.title: A light-efficient and versatile multiplexing method for snapshot spectral imaging
sources.authors: David Andersson; Yupan Bao; Vassily Kornienko; Dean Popovic; Elias Kristensson
sources.reviewed: full primary article: FRAME, setup, calibration and quantitative temperature mapping sections
sources.verified_mechanism: Passive spectral separation, channel-specific spatial carriers and Fourier lock-in recovery; temperature mapping and blackbody/flat-field calibration
sources.project_implication: Spatial encoding plus single-camera temperature mapping is prior art; spatial bandwidth and dynamic range are shared resources

sources.title: Multispectral coded light for high-speed temperature imaging of aluminum combustion
sources.authors: David Andersson; Zhiyong Wu; Edouard Berrocal; Zhongshan Li; Elias Kristensson
sources.reviewed: author institution abstract and publication record; publisher full text unavailable through browser tool in this pass
sources.verified_mechanism: Passive FRAME with one high-speed monochrome camera; author abstract reports native acquisition at 50 kHz and temperature maps from 2000 to 4000 K
sources.project_implication: Direct thermometry prior art. Capture rate is not reconstruction throughput; no detailed accuracy comparison is inferred from the abstract

sources.title: SGDE: Self-supervised Geometry Degradation Estimation Framework for Coded Aperture Compressive Spectral Imaging
sources.reviewed: official abstract and paper introduction/contribution paragraphs
sources.verified_mechanism: Explicit affine mask-misalignment model, joint self-supervised estimation and multi-kernel initialization
sources.project_implication: Motivates testing physical calibration mismatch; this CASSI mechanism does not establish identifiable blind calibration for six spatial carriers

sources.title: Proximal Algorithms
sources.reviewed: author publication page and section 2.3 (PDF page 13): firm nonexpansiveness
sources.verified_mechanism: Convex proximal maps are firmly nonexpansive; minimizers are proximal fixed points
sources.project_implication: Weighted-norm extension and correction-retention diagnostic in this report are mathematical deductions under fixed-frame convex assumptions, not a claim about the whole learned network
